requirements.contract: ARM global prefix/postfix missing values are empty; values dollar-expanded before service spawn composition.
START_SYSTEM_SERVICES and START_USER_SERVICES invalid values shut down with global_ret1; missing both selects both, missing one does not automatically enable that category.
Neither selected service category is a startup error, even if registry would be empty.
RESOURCE_DIAGNOSTICS is optional filename/open-w mode under HAVE_WAIT4; open failure logs and falls back to ordinary wait.
Register shutdown and SIGCHLD-read tasks before service enumeration; start all forced entries before creating notifier, so initial starts have no monitor replay.
Ignore ARM section; include every other section with BINARY present, not only IMMEDIATE_START or START_ON_DEMAND.
RUN_PER_USER exactly YES selects user category, otherwise system; respect category selection.
Service names compare case-insensitively and preserve original spelling; duplicate case-insensitive name ignored.
CONFIG filename getter falls back to PATHS DEFAULTCONFIG; failed stat discards filename and child receives no -c; existence check does not require a regular file.
Register service at list head; preserve resulting registry order for initial starts, LIST, shutdown and restart scans.
Initial backoff1ms, restart_atFOREVER, last_started_at0, killed_at0, last_exit0, no pending stop or process.
PIPECONTROL exactly YES controls child signal pipe.
IMMEDIATE_START YES sets force_start; NOARMBIND YES only bypasses listeners in that branch.
Otherwise START_ON_DEMAND must equal YES to bind listeners, but the registered service remains explicitly startable without listeners.
Address computation/bind failure leaves the service registered and does not suppress its immediate-start flag.
Registry is built once; restart scan comment about configuration changes is not a public hot-reload implementation.
DISABLEV6 malformed is fatal to endpoint collection; IPv6 probing distinguishes ENOBUFS/ENOMEM/ENFILE/EACCES from unsupported-family errors.
PORT missing means0; malformed logs but can continue with0; values above65535 fail endpoint collection.
UNIXPATH filename expansion and native length shortening precede bind; Linux TESTING USE_ABSTRACT_SOCKETS selects abstract sockets.
Normal Unix path parent directory creation failure logs and continues into actual bind; no new private endpoint option.
Unix support probing has the same resource/permission hard-error classes as IPv6 support probing.
No usable port or Unix path rejects endpoint collection; START_ON_DEMAND YES additionally emits missing-address diagnostic.
BINDTO uses native getaddrinfo family/protocol/socktype filtering; keep returned order and IPv4/IPv6 ABI data without hostname-to-protocol substitution.
Without BINDTO, endpoints are wildcard IPv6 then IPv4 unless IPv6 disabled; optional Unix endpoint is first.
Keep borrowed numeric/opaque sockaddr values out of no_std owner; actual address resolution belongs to host and must not use public DNS in local tests.
Create STREAM sockets; SO_REUSEADDR and IPv6 V6ONLY attempted before bind; listen backlog5.
Unix precheck and UNIX_MATCH_UID/GID permission mode policy are not peer-credential authentication; do not add match-UID rejection to child activation.
One address bind/listen failure logs/closes that socket and allows other service addresses; do not claim all-listeners success.
Successful sockets remain parent-owned for demand and for repeated child inherit; child mapping must duplicate, not consume parent listener.
Retain safe Unix path inode guard and private parent cleanup; do not unlink foreign/replaced paths while matching legitimate C behavior.
Demand trigger observes readability only, cancels the current read task, and starts service; it never accept()s the queued connection.
Starting one service cancels all its listener readiness tasks before native launch. A readiness event for stale service/listener generation cannot launch a replacement.
All managed services inherit stdout+stderr; request reserved/std-inheritance field is not applied by daemon.
Configured PIPECONTROL uses one-byte signal pipe in addition to inherited listeners.
Per-service PREFIX overrides GLOBAL_PREFIX and is dollar-expanded; OPTIONS optional string expanded; GLOBAL_POSTFIX replaces all {} with service name and is prepended before final dollar expansion.
DEBUG uses C enum truthiness: malformed SYSERR(-1) is also true in command composition; TYPE SIMPLE selected only by successful choice, otherwise GNUNET.
GNUNET type resolves binary via project libexec helper and forms prefix,binary,optional -L DEBUG,optional -c config,options textual command.
Textual command uses official custom GNUNET_process_run_command parsing, not a shell or standard shell_words parser.
SIMPLE uses filename=prefix, argv0=binary, argv1=whole options, no implied executable from binary; empty prefix fails normal helper precheck.
Native command precheck/fork failure returns START_FAILED, destroys process object and does not itself rearm demand listeners or schedule restart.
Actual fork admission success sets last_started_at UTC now, broadcasts STARTING then sends request STARTING; no application readiness guarantee.
Later execvp failure is real child exit1 after STARTING, not pre-fork START_FAILED; std Command::spawn alone changes that observable boundary.
Demand start does not set force_start; explicit START and IMMEDIATE_START do. Starting resets neither backoff nor killed_at.
Do not let host awaits expose a second start for the same pending spawn; leased spawn generation must prevent duplicate actual children.
Signal via control pipe first; exact one-byte write succeeds, otherwise fall back to native kill(pid,sig); never signal a reused PID after releasing its child owner.
Process object destruction closes owned mappings/control pipe but does not implicitly kill or reap; lifecycle requires an explicit owned child drain policy.
Register START8/STOP9 variable-size request handlers with final NUL check; first embedded NUL selects name and final NUL is still required.
MONITOR14/TEST15 require exact4-byte frames; LIST12 requires exact16-byte GNUNET_ARM_Message; known wrong-size is MQ protocol failure.
Unknown type follows actual generic MQ dispatch policy; do not invent rejection solely because absent from ARM handler table.
Generic service MANUAL_SHUTDOWN|CLOSE_LSOCKS options have startup/runtime semantics independent of ARM private control fields.
Continue client processing before action; shutdown check precedes name lookup.
Unknown START replies IS_NOT_KNOWN; known START sets force_startYES before testing existing process.
Known process replies IS_STARTED_ALREADY; otherwise executes native start. No synthetic IS_STARTING_ALREADY state is emitted by this daemon.
STOP arm is case-insensitive and precedes global-shutdown/name lookup; broadcast STOPPING with request spelling, queue STOPPING result, persist client, schedule scheduler shutdown.
Queued self-stop result/status is not a guaranteed physical-write barrier before shutdown; client EOF before RESULT_STOPPING remains Disconnected, after RESULT_STOPPING becomes SentOk/Stopped.
Other STOP unknown returns IS_NOT_KNOWN; known sets force_startNO before shutdown/stopping/stopped checks.
Other STOP precedence is IN_SHUTDOWN, IS_STOPPING_ALREADY, IS_STOPPED_ALREADY, then actual TERM and pending completion.
TERM failure logs but pending stop remains until actual child exit; do not fabricate STOPPED or introduce arbitrary grace/SIGKILL timeout.
Pending stop retains requesting ClientId and opaque request ID; one ordinary stop completion is sent after reaping, not after kill syscall.
Nonzero LIST reserved field logs break-op but still returns list; preserve opaque request ID bytes and C aggregate ABI.
LIST contains all registered non-ARM services in registry order, name/binary string pool, status, last_exit16, restart_at and last_started UTC.
No process: never-started=>STOPPED, prior exit0=>FINISHED, prior nonzero=>FAILED; process plus pending stopping client or global shutdown=>STOPPING, otherwise STARTED.
Exact native ABI profile is explicit: align8 LIST prefix24/RESULT24; align4 requires independent profile evidence; per-service info28.
Preflight count, pool offsets and total frame<=65535 without u16/usize wrap; reject resource/oversized output explicitly rather than wrapping or emitting empty success.
TEST returns exact4-byte TEST and continues processing; response follows actual output ownership, not synchronous transport acknowledgement.
Monitor registration deduplicates MQ membership but sends direct arm/MONITORING_STARTED on every request.
Registration has no snapshot of running services; retain original configured service name in start/exit notifications.
All generic clients are mark_monitor and do not delay daemon shutdown; STOP-arm client persist is an explicit exception.
Optional status notification is skipped only when actual logical MQ length>1024, not >=1024.
Broadcast order is subscriber-list order; required direct responses are not optional queue drops.
Monitor EOF removes subscriber exactly once; recycled ClientId must never receive old stop completion or queued notification.
Disconnect clears killing_client pointer but leaves request-id storage; do not keep a zombie client authority.
Since LIST uses killing_client as stopping marker, disconnect can change a still-live terminating service LIST state back to STARTED.
A later STOP may establish a new stop requester and signal again after prior requester EOF; do not add an independent permanent stopping flag that changes this behavior.
SIGCHLD writes one signal byte preserving errno; reactor drains up to16 bytes then scans all owned service children because signals may coalesce.
Use waitpid/wait4 on each owned native child PID/token with WNOHANG; never reap unrelated children with waitpid(-1).
Not-ready/error/STOPPED/UNKNOWN/RUNNING results leave the process owner; actual Exited/Signaled is required for stop completion.
Destroy native process owner, clear proc, broadcast STOPPED, complete pending stop and clear it, then compute backoff or free during shutdown.
Exit code and signal number feed same LIST last_exit value; status reason itself is not a separate wire field.
With HAVE_WAIT4 and open diagnostics file, append actual rusage for reaped child; C user/system microseconds use /10e6, not /1e6, and source formatting must be an explicit profile decision.
A stale child generation/result must not reap, free, notify, or restart the new child occupying same service slot.
Clean Exited/0 sets restart_at0 and rearms all demand listeners; does not itself schedule a forced restart, even force_startYES.
Abnormal exit cool-down duration is measured from old restart_at, not last_started_at; future FOREVER yields0 duration.
Minutes=floor(duration/60s); >31 sets backoff0, otherwise bit-shifts current backoff right by minutes.
Set restart_at=UTCnow+current reduced backoff with official FOREVER/overflow saturation, then update backoff=min15min,2*max1ms,backoff.
Cancel prior global restart task and schedule one immediate IDLE-priority scan; no jitter or invented per-service worker timer.
Preserve source UTC comparisons on wall-clock jumps; use monotonic reactor waits only as re-evaluated wake hints, not a silent protocol-time substitution.
Skip active children; due nonrunning force_start service launches, due on-demand service rearms previously paused listener tasks.
Select minimum future restart remaining duration and schedule one IDLE timer only if finite; FOREVER produces no timer.
A launch failure inside scan does not itself create a new future restart deadline; other services can still determine next scan.
Initial explicit START bypasses restart cooldown; only automatic restart/demand rearm paths wait on restart_at.

Enter shutdown, cancel restart timer, close all managed service listeners/read tasks before TERM all children. Keep the separate ARM control IPC listener and ordinary handlers accepting throughout manual Draining: new TEST still echoes and START returns IN_SHUTDOWN before name lookup; final generic service shutdown closes ARM control admission only after real children drain.
Free service entries already without child; wait for each real remaining owned child exit and continue reaping.
Pending client output or optional monitor backlog must not prevent listener close/TERM/reap progress with caller-bounded effect capacity.
No implicit timeout/SIGKILL escalation or invented successful child cleanup; a still-running child keeps manual shutdown pending.
Destroy notification context and generic service only after all registry children gone; cancel SIGCHLD read task at final phase.
Finally close resource log, uninstall signal handler and close self-pipe; preserve process-global capture/descriptor preconditions and close-after-bind option4 separately.
Provide all13 ARM options: end,init,kill,all,start,restart,delete,monitor,quiet,timeout,info,no-stdout,no-stderr with official short names.
Generic PROGRAM_run options, GNUNET_ARGS/config/project paths, diagnostics and help/version are additional obligations, not supplied by an ARM wire codec.
Action order is stop specific, end/restart ARM, start ARM, init specific, LIST, monitor; advance phase before waiting callback.
Native ARM liveness test precedes actions that would otherwise retry indefinitely; missing ARM ordinary service action sets exit4.
Restart while ARM absent becomes start; initial ARM self launch respects no-stdout/no-stderr, managed service START has no stdio override.
Monitor phase clears quiet and keeps process running until interrupt/timeout; only one current request owner retained and canceled during cleanup.
Duplicate config, require PATHS GNUNET_HOME raw string, retain ARM CONFIG filename, connect owner and optional separate monitor channel.
Schedule timeout only when nonzero; actual timeout exits2; first connection SYSERR shuts down without automatically inventing exit1.
Several failure callbacks log/shutdown without setting global ret (still0); preserve exact version behavior or document a deliberate CLI discrepancy.
START accepts STARTING or IS_STARTED_ALREADY; ARM stop accepts STOPPING/STOPPED/IS_STOPPED_ALREADY, particular stop accepts STOPPED/IS_STOPPED_ALREADY.
Successful ARM stop clears end flag; restart clears restart and sets start before advancing action sequence.
Communication/list NULL failures set exit3; show-all includes stopped entries; quiet suppresses headings not row output.
STOPPING/unknown rows can be printed twice by count loop and main print loop; source text/format belongs to explicit CLI profile, not new wire semantics.
FAILED/FINISHED remain visible without all; failure messages use source last_exit16 and UTC restart remaining.
Delete configured config file and GNUNET_HOME recursively only along exact CLI cleanup path and explicit user request; never test against real user data.
Cancel action/current operation/timer, disconnect command and monitor owners, then delete only if end&&delete at cleanup.
Because successful stop already clears end, source delete trigger differs from option prose; record this before proposing a safe compatible CLI implementation.
Start-peer command resolves testbed system trait, creates/loads/reconfigures actual peer config, writes DEFAULTCONFIG, and owns actual ARM native child.
Wrapper launch uses run_command_va with main_binary prefix-or-libexec and args libexec-or-empty as argv0; options are whole varargs, not shell parsing.
First ARM connection YES finishes async command; first failure fails; no fake readiness from native child creation alone.
Cleanup disconnects ARM, TERM+blocking-waits actual owned child, destroys process/config; safe Rust must take ownership once and retain parent testbed lifetimes.
Stop command borrows start-peer ARM trait and issues request stop arm; cleanup of incomplete command cancels its operation.
Source stop callback tests result only and ignores RequestStatus; Disconnected result is undefined and must not be interpreted as safe Stopped success.
Expose borrowed ARM/config and existing process trait with lifetimes tied to live start command; four ARM get/make traits are real API obligations, not untyped trait-map placeholders.

existing_rust_scope: gnunet-arm-core provides client/monitor sans-I/O ownership and ARM codecs. No ARM daemon server or lifecycle/CLI/testing-wrapper promotion follows from this design or normal C probes.
